svg.title: FIFO broadcast: receive out of order, deliver in order
svg.desc: Time proceeds downward. Sender A broadcasts (A,0,m0) then (A,1,m1). One receiver B is shown, with separate timelines for its FIFO layer and application. The FIFO layer receives m1 first and buffers it because delivered[A] is 0. When m0 arrives, the FIFO layer delivers m0 to the application, increments delivered[A] to 1, then immediately delivers buffered m1 and increments delivered[A] to 2. The two delivery events are spaced vertically for clarity. This ordering guarantee is per sender. Crossing message paths do not represent an event.
svg.metadata: Based on the user-supplied FIFO broadcast algorithm slide by Martin Kleppmann. LaTeX/TikZ drawing using Latin Modern fonts and the same monochrome line and arrow styling as the supplied message-ordering SVG. All labels are vector outlines.
